archetypes.name: dyn-statusline-security
archetypes.rationale: Statusline installer writes user-local and repo-local files.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new progress statusline installer and SessionStart hook. Focus on symlink refusal, containment of repo-local writes, preservation of existing local settings, and whether untrusted statusline JSON or user settings can inject unintended commands or output into model context. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
